DeepGHS anime face model notice

The deepghs/anime_face_detection model card declares MIT. The bundled
face_detect_v1.4_n/model.onnx is pinned to an upstream revision and locked by
size and SHA-256 in cmake/smart-crop-models.json. Independent provenance for
the exact weight file has not been confirmed. The project maintainer has
approved distribution of this pinned file for the Windows x64 CUDA smart-crop
package with that limitation recorded in the release evidence.

Upstream reference:
- https://huggingface.co/deepghs/anime_face_detection
